name: BINA48
summary: A head-and-shoulders android commissioned by the Terasem Movement and built by David Hanson, modeled on a real person, Bina Aspen Rothblatt, from recorded interviews, a laser life-mask and voice data. BINA48 is an ongoing experiment in whether a 'mindfile' plus conversational AI can approximate a specific human personality.
notable: Attempt to port one specific person's personality into a robot
Long-running subject of transhumanist 'mind uploading' research
